description: This file defines a setup command for a command-line interface, which writes a default configuration to a specified path. It uses the Commander library for CLI parsing, Foundation for system tasks, and Swabble for project-specific configuration handling.

classes.name: SetupCommand
classes.description: A command-line command to generate and save a default configuration file.
